property_summary: After any call to settle that may succeed or fail for a caller, the reference contract always clears the stored guess.block for that caller (making guesses[msg].block == 0), whereas the mutant that omits clearing can leave guesses[msg].block nonzero for some input, so a second settle call may observe a nonzero stored block when the reference always has zero.
change_summary: Omit clearing the stored block (remove 'guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;'), leaving the guess record intact after settle.
